ValidationRule.description: R-VQ2: Completed Date is required when Status is Completed and may not be in the future; Expires may not be earlier than Completed Date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'), ISBLANK(Completed_Date__c)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Completed_Date__c)), Completed_Date__c > TODAY()), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Completed_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Expires__c)), Expires__c < Completed_Date__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A completed step needs a completed date that is not in the future, and it cannot expire before it was completed.
